title: Spotify’s Creator Milestone Awards Get a Refresh to Celebrate Podcast Success

body_markdown:
Since


[launching in January 2025](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-01-27/creator-milestone-awards-podcasts/) , Spotify’s Creator Milestone Awards have celebrated podcasts around the world reaching major milestones on our platform. Now, we’re introducing a refreshed look and a few updates to the program as we recognize the latest group of creators making their mark on Spotify.


The awards will now recognize podcasts based on cumulative plays, with milestones of **5**


**00 million, 250 million, and 100 million plays** (or


**50 million plays** for the first milestone in emerging markets), reflecting Spotify’s broader shift from


[streams to plays](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-06-11/spotify-for-creators-tools-plays-analytics-updates/) as a key measure of podcast success.


This fall, we’re also introducing a new design direction across the physical awards and billboard campaign, inspired by Spotify’s Scandinavian roots and celebrating creator achievements through sculptural forms, distinct materials, and craftsmanship. Moving forward, winners will be announced twice a year, with celebrations continuing through our on-platform


[editorial hub](https://open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5DAqbMKFL9xynmsOBJz) , social media spotlights, and other opportunities to share these moments with fans.


As podcasting continues to grow, we’re proud to celebrate the creators behind the shows that keep audiences listening, watching, and coming back for more.


Congratulations to all of our latest Creator Milestone Award recipients!


*Visit our*[Creator Milestone Awards hub](https://open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5DAqbMKFL9xynmsOBJz) *to explore the full list of winners on Spotify.*
